title: Urgent Nashik onion sale
description: A Marathi-speaking onion farmer needs buyer pickup within two days.

listing.notes: Medium-to-large bulbs. Farmer has limited covered storage and strongly prefers buyer pickup.

intake_dialogue.speaker: intake_agent
intake_dialogue.text: नमस्कार. मी कृषी आवाज सहाय्यक बोलत आहे. तुम्हाला कोणता माल विकायचा आहे आणि माल कुठे आहे?
intake_dialogue.english_translation: Hello. This is the Krishi Awaaz assistant. What produce do you want to sell, and where is it located?

intake_dialogue.speaker: farmer
intake_dialogue.text: नमस्कार. माझ्याकडे निफाडला ५० क्विंटल उन्हाळी कांदा आहे. पाच दिवसांपूर्वी काढला आहे आणि दोन दिवसांत विकायचा आहे.
intake_dialogue.english_translation: Hello. I have 50 quintals of summer onion in Niphad. It was harvested five days ago and I need to sell it within two days.

intake_dialogue.speaker: intake_agent
intake_dialogue.text: कांद्याचा आकार आणि दर्जा कसा आहे? किमान किती भाव हवा आहे? गाडी तुम्ही लावणार की व्यापाऱ्याने माल उचलावा?
intake_dialogue.english_translation: What are the onion size and grade? What is your minimum price? Will you arrange transport, or should the buyer collect it?

intake_dialogue.speaker: farmer
intake_dialogue.text: बहुतेक कांदा मध्यम ते मोठा आहे; थोडा बी ग्रेड मिसळलेला आहे. क्विंटलला १,७५० रुपयांपेक्षा कमी नको. व्यापाऱ्याने शेतातून उचलला तर बरे.
intake_dialogue.english_translation: Most onions are medium to large, with a little grade B mixed in. I do not want less than ₹1,750 per quintal. It would be better if the buyer collects from the farm.

intake_dialogue.speaker: intake_agent
intake_dialogue.text: मी पुन्हा सांगतो: निफाड येथे ५० क्विंटल उन्हाळी कांदा, ए/बी मिश्र दर्जा, किमान ₹१,७५०, आणि ४८ तासांत विक्री. हे बरोबर आहे का?
intake_dialogue.english_translation: Let me confirm: 50 quintals of summer onion in Niphad, mixed A/B grade, minimum ₹1,750, and sale within 48 hours. Is that correct?

intake_dialogue.speaker: farmer
intake_dialogue.text: हो, बरोबर. वजन करताना जास्त कपात नको, तेही आधी सांगा.
intake_dialogue.english_translation: Yes, correct. I also do not want excessive deductions during weighing, so clarify that in advance.

middlemen.name: Vilas Patil
middlemen.negotiation_style: Starts low, but pays more for a full truck-sized lot and confirms pickup quickly.

middlemen.name: Rafiq Shaikh
middlemen.negotiation_style: Offers same-day payment but expects the farmer to deliver to the warehouse.

middlemen.name: Suresh More
middlemen.negotiation_style: Firm price ceiling and slower payment; often below the farmer's floor.

title: Ludhiana wheat lot with flexible timing
description: A Punjabi-speaking farmer values reliable weighing and fast payment over the absolute highest quote.

listing.notes: Stored under cover. Farmer can arrange transport but wants transparent weighing and payment within two days.

intake_dialogue.speaker: intake_agent
intake_dialogue.text: ਸਤ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਅਕਾਲ ਜੀ। ਤੁਸੀਂ ਕਿਹੜੀ ਫਸਲ ਵੇਚਣੀ ਹੈ, ਕਿੰਨੀ ਮਾਤਰਾ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਮਾਲ ਕਿੱਥੇ ਪਿਆ ਹੈ?
intake_dialogue.english_translation: Hello. Which crop do you want to sell, how much is there, and where is it stored?

intake_dialogue.speaker: farmer
intake_dialogue.text: ਮੇਰੇ ਕੋਲ ਮੁੱਲਾਂਪੁਰ ਦਾਖਾ ਵਿੱਚ 120 ਕੁਇੰਟਲ PBW 826 ਕਣਕ ਪਈ ਹੈ। ਨਮੀ ਸਾਢੇ ਗਿਆਰਾਂ ਫੀਸਦੀ ਦੇ ਕਰੀਬ ਹੈ।
intake_dialogue.english_translation: I have 120 quintals of PBW 826 wheat in Mullanpur Dakha. Moisture is around eleven and a half percent.

intake_dialogue.speaker: intake_agent
intake_dialogue.text: ਤੁਹਾਡਾ ਘੱਟੋ-ਘੱਟ ਭਾਅ ਕੀ ਹੈ? ਕਿੰਨੇ ਦਿਨਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਵੇਚਣੀ ਹੈ, ਅਤੇ ਟਰਾਂਸਪੋਰਟ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਕਰ ਸਕਦੇ ਹੋ?
intake_dialogue.english_translation: What is your minimum price? How soon do you need to sell, and can you arrange transport?

intake_dialogue.speaker: farmer
intake_dialogue.text: ₹2,425 ਤੋਂ ਘੱਟ ਨਹੀਂ ਦੇਣੀ। ਦਸ ਦਿਨ ਦਾ ਸਮਾਂ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਟਰਾਲੀ ਮੈਂ ਲਾ ਸਕਦਾ ਹਾਂ, ਪਰ ਤੋਲ ਸਾਫ਼ ਹੋਵੇ ਤੇ ਪੈਸਾ ਦੋ ਦਿਨਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਆ ਜਾਵੇ।
intake_dialogue.english_translation: I will not sell below ₹2,425. I have ten days and can arrange a trolley, but weighing must be transparent and payment should arrive within two days.

intake_dialogue.speaker: intake_agent
intake_dialogue.text: ਪੁਸ਼ਟੀ ਲਈ: 120 ਕੁਇੰਟਲ PBW 826 ਕਣਕ, FAQ ਦਰਜਾ, ਘੱਟੋ-ਘੱਟ ₹2,425, ਦਸ ਦਿਨਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਵਿਕਰੀ ਅਤੇ ਵੱਧ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਦੋ ਦਿਨਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਭੁਗਤਾਨ। ਠੀਕ ਹੈ?
intake_dialogue.english_translation: To confirm: 120 quintals PBW 826 wheat, FAQ grade, minimum ₹2,425, sale within ten days, and payment within two days. Correct?

intake_dialogue.speaker: farmer
intake_dialogue.text: ਹਾਂ ਜੀ, ਠੀਕ ਹੈ। ਜੇ ਭਰੋਸੇਯੋਗ ਖਰੀਦਦਾਰ ਹੋਵੇ ਤਾਂ ਦਸ-ਵੀਹ ਰੁਪਏ ਦਾ ਫਰਕ ਚੱਲ ਜਾਵੇਗਾ, ਪਰ ਘੱਟੋ-ਘੱਟ ਭਾਅ ਤੋਂ ਹੇਠਾਂ ਨਹੀਂ।
intake_dialogue.english_translation: Yes. A difference of ten or twenty rupees is acceptable for a reliable buyer, but not below the minimum price.

middlemen.name: Harjit Brar
middlemen.negotiation_style: Transparent weighing and fast payment, but farmer delivers.

middlemen.name: Maninder Gill
middlemen.negotiation_style: Strong price and buyer pickup, offset by slower payment.

middlemen.name: Baldev Arora
middlemen.negotiation_style: Immediate settlement but a strict purchasing ceiling.

title: Same-day Madurai tomato sale
description: A Tamil-speaking farmer has highly perishable tomatoes that must move today.

listing.notes: Harvested yesterday evening. Crates are available, but produce must leave before night.

intake_dialogue.speaker: intake_agent
intake_dialogue.text: வணக்கம். எந்த விளைபொருளை விற்க விரும்புகிறீர்கள்? எவ்வளவு உள்ளது, எங்கே உள்ளது?
intake_dialogue.english_translation: Hello. What produce do you want to sell, how much is available, and where is it?

intake_dialogue.speaker: farmer
intake_dialogue.text: அலங்காநல்லூரில் 30 குவிண்டால் தக்காளி இருக்கிறது. நேற்று மாலை பறித்தது; இன்று இரவுக்குள் எடுத்துச் செல்ல வேண்டும்.
intake_dialogue.english_translation: I have 30 quintals of tomatoes in Alanganallur. They were harvested yesterday evening and must be moved before tonight.

intake_dialogue.speaker: intake_agent
intake_dialogue.text: தக்காளியின் நிலை எப்படி இருக்கிறது? குறைந்தபட்சமாக குவிண்டாலுக்கு என்ன விலை வேண்டும்? பெட்டிகளும் வண்டியும் தயாரா?
intake_dialogue.english_translation: What condition are the tomatoes in? What minimum price do you need per quintal? Are crates and transport ready?

intake_dialogue.speaker: farmer
intake_dialogue.text: பழம் சிவப்பாக இருக்கிறது, ஆனால் இன்னும் உறுதியாக உள்ளது. பெட்டிகள் இருக்கின்றன. குவிண்டாலுக்கு ₹1,050-க்கு கீழே வேண்டாம்; வாங்குபவர் வண்டி அனுப்பினால் நல்லது.
intake_dialogue.english_translation: The tomatoes are red but still firm. I have crates. I do not want below ₹1,050 per quintal, and it would help if the buyer sends a vehicle.

intake_dialogue.speaker: intake_agent
intake_dialogue.text: உறுதி செய்கிறேன்: 30 குவிண்டால் பழுத்தும் உறுதியான தக்காளி, குறைந்தபட்சம் ₹1,050, இன்று இரவுக்குள் எடுத்துச் செல்ல வேண்டும். சரியா?
intake_dialogue.english_translation: Confirming: 30 quintals of ripe but firm tomatoes, minimum ₹1,050, and pickup before tonight. Correct?

intake_dialogue.speaker: farmer
intake_dialogue.text: ஆம். உடனே பணம் கிடைத்தால் கொஞ்சம் குறைந்த விலையையும் பரிசீலிப்பேன், ஆனால் ₹1,050-க்கு கீழே ஒப்புக்கொள்ள வேண்டாம்.
intake_dialogue.english_translation: Yes. I may consider a slightly lower comparison if payment is immediate, but do not agree below ₹1,050.

middlemen.name: Kannan Velu
middlemen.negotiation_style: Can dispatch a vehicle quickly and pays immediately.

middlemen.name: Fathima Banu
middlemen.negotiation_style: Buys for a hotel network, values consistent grade, and negotiates in smaller increments.

middlemen.name: Selvam Ravi
middlemen.negotiation_style: Distant market, no pickup, and likely to remain below the farmer's floor.

title: Guntur dried chilli quality negotiation
description: A Telugu-speaking farmer sells a smaller high-value chilli lot where quality and delayed payment matter.

listing.notes: Bagged and stored dry. Farmer wants the buyer to state quality deductions before pickup.

intake_dialogue.speaker: intake_agent
intake_dialogue.text: నమస్కారం. మీరు ఏ పంట అమ్మాలనుకుంటున్నారు? ఎంత పరిమాణం ఉంది, సరుకు ఎక్కడ ఉంది?
intake_dialogue.english_translation: Hello. Which crop do you want to sell, how much is available, and where is it located?

intake_dialogue.speaker: farmer
intake_dialogue.text: ప్రత్తిపాడు దగ్గర 20 క్వింటాళ్ల తేజ ఎండు మిర్చి ఉంది. కొంత 334 రకం కలిసింది, తేమ తక్కువగా ఉంది.
intake_dialogue.english_translation: I have 20 quintals of dried Teja chilli near Prathipadu. Some 334 variety is mixed in, and moisture is low.

intake_dialogue.speaker: intake_agent
intake_dialogue.text: మీ కనీస ధర ఎంత? ఎన్ని రోజుల్లో అమ్మాలి? నాణ్యత పేరుతో కోతలకు ఏమైనా షరతు ఉందా?
intake_dialogue.english_translation: What is your minimum price? How soon must it be sold? Do you have conditions regarding quality deductions?

intake_dialogue.speaker: farmer
intake_dialogue.text: క్వింటాల్‌కు ₹14,200 కంటే తక్కువ వద్దు. వారం రోజుల్లో అమ్మాలి. రంగు లేదా తేమ పేరుతో ఎంత కోత పెడతారో ముందే చెప్పాలి; తర్వాత మార్చకూడదు.
intake_dialogue.english_translation: I do not want less than ₹14,200 per quintal. It should sell within a week. Any colour or moisture deduction must be disclosed in advance and not changed later.

intake_dialogue.speaker: intake_agent
intake_dialogue.text: ధృవీకరిస్తున్నాను: 20 క్వింటాళ్ల తేజ/334 మిశ్రమ ఎండు మిర్చి, కనీస ధర ₹14,200, ఏడు రోజుల్లో అమ్మకం, కోతలు ముందే స్పష్టంగా చెప్పాలి. సరేనా?
intake_dialogue.english_translation: Confirming: 20 quintals of mixed Teja/334 dried chilli, minimum ₹14,200, sale within seven days, and deductions disclosed in advance. Correct?

intake_dialogue.speaker: farmer
intake_dialogue.text: అవును. వెంటనే మొత్తం డబ్బు రాకపోయినా రెండు రోజుల్లో వస్తే సరిపోతుంది.
intake_dialogue.english_translation: Yes. It is acceptable if full payment arrives within two days, even if it is not immediate.

middlemen.name: Venkata Reddy
middlemen.negotiation_style: Export-oriented buyer who pays for colour but insists on inspection.

middlemen.name: Srinivas Rao
middlemen.negotiation_style: Local processor with immediate payment and moderate price flexibility.

middlemen.name: Anil Kumar
middlemen.negotiation_style: Distant buyer with a low ceiling and slower settlement.
